title: The specified integral quotient Roos completion is a reflector
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l and any scheme T, let B be the completed integral coefficient sheaf and C its specified strict quotient Roos completion with augmentation eta [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-weil-integral-reduction-tower]. Given the adic datum with ideal generated by the specified uniformizer [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], C(H) is intrinsically complete; precomposition with eta_H gives a bijection Hom(C(H),L) to Hom(H,L) for every intrinsically complete L; and eta_H is invertible exactly when the intrinsic Koszul unit is invertible on every complex representative of H [def-sf-integral-koszul-intrinsic-unit]. Site and coefficient universes are independent; complexes are unbounded.

source.place: Tags 099B and 0A0E, lemma-derived-completion and lemma-derived-completion-koszul; proetale.tex Tag 099M; normalized actual quotient unit and arbitrary representatives.

proof.text: Transport the coefficient ring, uniformizer section and strict quotient diagram through a small-model site equivalence in the coefficient universe. Apply the ringed Koszul completion reflector for the one-element generating list.

Use exact countable products, the strict Roos comparison and the completed Koszul-to-quotient comparison to identify the signed product-fiber unit with the actual quotient augmentation on flat-term K-flat representatives. Descend the unit-compatible isomorphism and transport complete output and the Hom bijection.

The finite free Koszul tensor functors preserve quasi-isomorphisms, and exact countable products preserve the quasi-isomorphisms of their towers. Hence the intrinsic unit condition is independent of every complex representative, without a K-flat restriction. Combine this with the reflector fixed-object condition.

lean.statement:
theorem integralRoosReflector
    (T : Scheme.{t})
    (d : AdicCoefficientDatum (Padic.coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))
    (hd : d.ideal = Ideal.span {Padic.coefficientExtensionUniformizer l E}) :
    (∀ H : IntegralOnSlice.D l E T none,
      ∀ (C : IntegralOnSlice.Cx l E T none)
        (rC : DerivedCategory.Q.obj C ≅ (IntegralOnSlice.completion l E T none).obj H),
        IsIso (integralKoszulIntrinsicUnit l E T _ C rC)) ∧
    (∀ H L : IntegralOnSlice.D l E T none,
      (∀ (C : IntegralOnSlice.Cx l E T none) (rC : DerivedCategory.Q.obj C ≅ L),
        IsIso (integralKoszulIntrinsicUnit l E T L C rC)) →
      Function.Bijective (fun f : (IntegralOnSlice.completion l E T none).obj H ⟶ L ↦
        (IntegralOnSlice.completionUnit l E T none).app H ≫ f)) ∧
    (∀ H : IntegralOnSlice.D l E T none,
      IsIso ((IntegralOnSlice.completionUnit l E T none).app H) ↔
        ∀ (C : IntegralOnSlice.Cx l E T none) (rC : DerivedCategory.Q.obj C ≅ H),
          IsIso (integralKoszulIntrinsicUnit l E T H C rC))
